items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Cubie was -- was fronting the band.

ctx.x: Well, Cubie was -- Cubie was -- was fronting the band. So, me and Roy used to get together and talk, so we used to go down to a place called the Moonglow. And, Ruben Blakely was the emcee there.
